orbit_cosmetic.manager.title: Orbit Cosmetic Manager
orbit_cosmetic.manager.sort.name: Name
orbit_cosmetic.manager.remove.title: Remove this cosmetic?
orbit_cosmetic.manager.remove.message: "%s" (%s) and its settings file will be deleted from the orbit folder. This cannot be undone.
orbit_cosmetic.manager.import.tooltip: Drag .bbmodel files onto this window to import them, or put them in the orbit folder
orbit_cosmetic.manager.import.help: Drag .bbmodel files onto the Minecraft window, or copy them into the folder that just opened.
orbit_cosmetic.manager.create.tooltip: Generate a Blockbench template with the player body and all anchor groups, and open it
orbit_cosmetic.manager.empty: No cosmetics yet. Drag .bbmodel files here or click Create.
orbit_cosmetic.manager.no_player: Join a world to see a preview
orbit_cosmetic.manager.hint: Select a cosmetic to see its details. Double-click to load or unload it.
orbit_cosmetic.manager.author: By %s
orbit_cosmetic.manager.duplicate: Same cosmetic as %s; only that file can be loaded
orbit_cosmetic.manager.over_limit: This server shows at most %s cosmetics; this one is hidden from others
orbit_cosmetic.manager.server.connected: Orbit server: up to %s cosmetics visible to others
orbit_cosmetic.manager.server.disabled: Orbit is disabled on this server
orbit_cosmetic.manager.server.blocked: You may not wear cosmetics on this server
orbit_cosmetic.animations.title: Animations: %s
orbit_cosmetic.animations.subtitle: Choose when each animation plays. Changes apply immediately.
orbit_cosmetic.animations.interrupt.tool: While this animation plays, animations of this cosmetic with a lower priority are paused
orbit_cosmetic.animations.advanced.toolt: Make parts react to how you move, like a cape lifting while you run
orbit_cosmetic.animations.none: This cosmetic has no animations. Use Advanced to make parts react to movement.
orbit_cosmetic.physics.title: Movement physics: %s
orbit_cosmetic.physics.subtitle: Parts that react to how the wearer moves (up to %s parts)
orbit_cosmetic.physics.empty: No parts react to movement yet. Click "Add part" to choose one.
orbit_cosmetic.physics.help: Axes as in Blockbench. Strength: pixels or degrees per block/second of movement (Turning: per quarter turn/second); negative reverses. Resistance: 0 reacts instantly, near 1 slowly and smoothly.
orbit_cosmetic.physics.source.none.toolt: This axis does not react to movement
orbit_cosmetic.physics.source.sideways.t: Speed to the right (positive) or left (negative)
orbit_cosmetic.physics.source.vertical.t: Speed up (positive) or down (negative), for example when jumping or falling
orbit_cosmetic.physics.source.speed.tool: Horizontal speed in any direction (never negative)
orbit_cosmetic.physics.source.turn.toolt: How fast the body turns: right is positive, left negative
orbit_cosmetic.parts.title: Choose a part
orbit_cosmetic.parts.subtitle: Groups of the cosmetic, by the body part they follow
orbit_cosmetic.trigger.none.tooltip: The animation is kept but never plays
orbit_cosmetic.trigger.idle.tooltip: Standing still on the ground (or riding)
orbit_cosmetic.trigger.walk.tooltip: Moving on the ground without sprinting
orbit_cosmetic.trigger.crouch.tooltip: In the crouching pose (also when forced to crouch under low ceilings)
orbit_cosmetic.trigger.fly.tooltip: Flying in creative mode or gliding with elytra
orbit_cosmetic.trigger.jump.tooltip: Starts when jumping; lasts until landing
orbit_cosmetic.trigger.random.tooltip: Plays once at random moments, waiting between the minimum and maximum wait. Every player sees it at the same moment.
orbit_cosmetic.loop.loop.tooltip: Repeats while the trigger is active
orbit_cosmetic.loop.once.tooltip: Plays once, then returns to the default (or idle) pose
orbit_cosmetic.loop.hold.tooltip: Plays once and holds the last frame while the trigger is active
orbit_cosmetic.settings.title: Orbit Cosmetic Settings
orbit_cosmetic.settings.others.tooltip: Draw cosmetics worn by other players
orbit_cosmetic.settings.first_person.too: Draw your arm cosmetics in first-person view
orbit_cosmetic.settings.animations.toolt: Play cosmetic animations (servers can disable them for everyone)
orbit_cosmetic.settings.icons.tooltip: Show the Orbit icon next to names of players using Orbit. It only means the player has Orbit; it says nothing about whether their cosmetics are safe or verified.
orbit_cosmetic.settings.own_nameplate.to: Show your own nameplate in third-person view, as other players see it
orbit_cosmetic.settings.downloads.toolti: Download cosmetics worn by other players from Orbit servers
orbit_cosmetic.settings.backend.tooltip: On servers without the Orbit server mod or plugin, share cosmetics with other Orbit players through the Orbit backend (set backendUrl in config/orbit_cosmetic.json). Servers with Orbit never use it.
orbit_cosmetic.settings.clear_cache.tool: Delete cosmetics downloaded from servers. They are downloaded again when needed.
orbit_cosmetic.settings.attach.animated_: Follow the player model being rendered, including Entity Model Features packs such as Fresh Animations
orbit_cosmetic.settings.attach.vanilla.t: Always follow the standard player model, ignoring custom player models
orbit_cosmetic.notice.disabled: Orbit cosmetics were disabled on this server.
orbit_cosmetic.notice.allowed: You can use Orbit cosmetics on this server.
orbit_cosmetic.notice.blocked: You may no longer wear Orbit cosmetics on this server.
orbit_cosmetic.settings.notifications.to: Show Orbit notifications: cosmetics loaded or failing, connections to Orbit Cloud or an Orbit server, bans, uploads and rejections.
orbit_cosmetic.manager.catalog.tooltip: Featured cosmetics from Orbit Cloud, checked by hand and safe to use
orbit_cosmetic.notify.connected_server.d: Cosmetics are shared through this server.
orbit_cosmetic.notify.uploaded_server.de: The server accepted it; other players can see it.
orbit_cosmetic.notify.connected_cloud.si: Signed in as %s. Orbit players here can see your cosmetics.
orbit_cosmetic.notify.connected_cloud.vi: View only: your Minecraft account could not be verified, so your cosmetics are not shared.
orbit_cosmetic.notify.connected_cloud.ba: You are banned: only featured cosmetics are shared.
orbit_cosmetic.notify.cloud_banned.until: Until %s. Only featured cosmetics are shared.
orbit_cosmetic.notify.cloud_unbanned: Your Orbit Cloud ban has ended
orbit_cosmetic.notify.uploaded_cloud.det: Now on Orbit Cloud for other players to see.
orbit_cosmetic.notify.too_big.detail: Orbit Cloud accepts models up to %s KiB. Only you can see it.
orbit_cosmetic.notify.report_sent.detail: Thank you. Orbit moderators will look into it.
orbit_cosmetic.notify.report_updated: You already reported this player this week; your report was updated.
orbit_cosmetic.players.tooltip: Orbit players on this server: hide their cosmetics or report them
orbit_cosmetic.players.title: Orbit Players
orbit_cosmetic.players.empty: No other Orbit players here yet.
orbit_cosmetic.players.report.tooltip: Tell the Orbit Cloud moderators about inappropriate cosmetics
orbit_cosmetic.players.hint: Hidden players stay hidden on every server until you show them again.
orbit_cosmetic.report.title: Report %s
orbit_cosmetic.report.explain: Reports go to the Orbit Cloud moderators with the cosmetics this player wears. Players reported by several people are reviewed and can be banned from Orbit Cloud.
orbit_cosmetic.report.unreachable: Orbit Cloud is not reachable right now. Try again later.
orbit_cosmetic.report.sign_in: Reporting needs a Minecraft account verified by Mojang; this account could not be verified.
orbit_cosmetic.catalog.title: Featured Catalog
orbit_cosmetic.catalog.subtitle: Cosmetics checked by hand by the Orbit team
orbit_cosmetic.catalog.empty: The catalog is empty for now.
orbit_cosmetic.catalog.hint: Select a cosmetic to see its details. Get downloads it into orbit/featured and loads it.
orbit_cosmetic.catalog.verified: ✔ Checked and safe to use. Still available if you are banned.
